note: Renders in /tmp/claude-0/w10 (16:19 UTC) match commit ed77bfe. The working tree has an UNCOMMITTED, unrendered edit to buildWelcomeGalley (git diff, l.367-372) that adds an opaque glossy pane in front of the cabinet contents. It is not scored here; see issue 1, because it risks a regression. Lighting is mid-iteration (from_integration.md), so the white fog band on the galley upper banks (m09, m12, q19, m01) and the flat white galley ceiling box (q19) are noted as lighting and not scored.

previousIssues.issue: w9a medium / w9b medium(a): welcome galley cabinet reads as a panelled door, not glass
previousIssues.status: partly fixed. The shelf-shadow rails and the opaque pane are gone, and the shelves and boxes now show. Two new problems: the interior renders far too dark, and the w9 sheen strips read as metal bars. The pane area samples m03 (680,300) #22201d against omaat_room_32 (800,600) #4e4c4b and lalf_134 (950,700) #605154, so it is about 2.2x too dark. The uncommitted working-tree edit removes the strips but puts a #2f2c2a opaque quad back at o+0.088 with dark silhouettes (#3a-#66). That would recreate the dark panelled-door look; see issue 1.

issues.detail: Welcome galley glass cabinet: interior 2.2x too dark, sheen strips read as poles; uncommitted pane edit risks re-creating the panelled door
issues.problem: The rendered cabinet (ed77bfe) shows a near-black empty box with two light uprights, so it reads as a cage, not a smoked-glass display. In both photos the glass reads as a mid grey-mauve tinted pane with the lit interior, white tray and papers clearly visible. The uncommitted working-tree change (l.367-372) puts a dark #2f2c2a metallic quad at o+0.088 in front of everything, with darker silhouettes #3a-#66. Under this lighting that would render about #25-#30, which is darker than now and loses the interior. It is the w8/w9 panelled-door problem again.
issues.evidence: w10/m03_welcome.png pane (680,300) #22201d; uprights (640,300) #716d68 and (712,300) #5c5752; w10/m16_welcomeObl.png the same at x~690/800, y 140-520. omaat_room_32.jpg pane (800,600) #4e4c4b, (820,500) #565151, papers and box visible at (735-905, 180-700). lalf_134.jpg pane (950,700) #605154 and (960,450) #614d4f, with the pale interior and white tray visible at (905-1010, 300-770).
issues.fix: 10_mono.js buildWelcomeGalley. (1) Keep the deletion of the three sheen strips (the old l.367 loop). (2) Do NOT add the opaque pane quad. If a glass cue is wanted, use one gQuad(0.34, 0.70) at o+0.088 only if MAT has a blended glass material (MAT.glass / alpha). Otherwise skip it. (3) Brighten what sits behind the glass so it reads as a lit cabinet seen through a tint. Back panel l.358: c '#2a2725' e 0.04 -> c '#5a5450' e 0.10. Shelves l.359: '#55514c' e 0.03 -> '#8a857d' e 0.08. Boxes l.360-362: multiply each colour by about 1.6 and set e 0.08 (e.g. '#4a4744' -> '#77726c', '#625e58' -> '#9d968d'). Add a white tray gBox(0.28, 0.02, 0.18) '#d8d4cc' e 0.06 at (gc+0.02, 1.215, o+0.06), as in lalf_134. (4) Add one 0.008 m wide, very faint vertical reflection quad only at the hinge stile, gQuad(0.008, 0.68) '#6b6661' r 0.05 at u -0.15, o+0.089. That is lalf_134's single hinge-side highlight, not two mid-pane bars. Target: the pane area mean about #4a-#55 in m03.

issues.problem: The jug's MONMAT.jug {#8f8e8a, m 0.6} renders flat mid grey, darker than the wall, with no specular highlight, so it reads as a ceramic or plastic pot. The real ANA pots are polished stainless with bright highlights and dark reflections. Every maker is also one unit about 0.33 m wide with a deep (0.12 m) projecting head and cheeks. sans_38 shows two or three narrow (~0.2 m) makers side by side, flush in the bank, each with a black top display and its own pot. In the welcome galley the same jug in the recess renders #4f4f4f against omaat_room_32's bright silver brewer.

issues.fix: 10_mono.js. (a) MONMAT.jug -> { c: '#d2d0ca', r: 0.12, m: 0.7 } and add a baked highlight in brewer(): B.add(gQuad(0.012, 0.07), P(-0.025, y0 - 0.04, 0.122), { c: '#f4f2ec', r: 0.1, e: 0.15 }) plus a darker reflection band gQuad(0.02, 0.06) '#3a3630' at P(0.02, y0 - 0.04, 0.121). Bend both quads onto the jug or place them just in front. (b) buildGalley t === 1 (l.485): replace the single brewer(B, ..., uW, 1.41) with two narrow makers: for (const s of [-1, 1]) brewer(B, (dx, y, oo) => G(s * uW / 4 + dx, y, o + oo), uW / 2 - 0.012, 1.41). In brewer(), reduce the head depth from 0.12 to 0.07 (gRBox(uW, 0.13, 0.07...) at o 0.035; control strip o 0.071; window o 0.0705). Make the fold-out handle a short gBox(uW*0.5, 0.012, 0.035) so it stops reading as a tray in m12.
